command:
set -euo pipefail
PRE=$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')
echo SUBJECT_BUEHNE_SHA=$PRE
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image,ImageFilter
import numpy as np, hashlib
root=Path('kopf_rgba_parallax')
rolls=['-25','-20','-15','-10','-05','+00','+05','+10','+15','+20','+25']
assert root.is_dir(), root
# Rebuild the accepted dynamic-eye support mask from existing canonical runtime assets.
def rgba(p): return np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert('RGBA'))
o=rgba(Path('augen_blink/blink_000.png')); c=rgba(Path('augen_blink/blink_006.png')); g=rgba(Path('augen_gaze/rotglow_tracking_master.png'))[:,:,3]>0
d=np.max(np.abs(o[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16)-c[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16)),axis=2)
gy,gx=np.where(g); focus=np.zeros_like(g); focus[max(0,gy.min()-35):min(g.shape[0],gy.max()+36),max(0,gx.min()-35):min(g.shape[1],gx.max()+36)]=1
m=(d>=70)&focus
m=np.asarray(Image.fromarray((m*255).astype('uint8')).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(5)).filter(ImageFilter.MinFilter(5)))>0
# top two connected components plus gaze support
h,w=m.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(m,bool); comps=[]
for y in range(h):
 for x in range(w):
  if not m[y,x] or seen[y,x]: continue
  q=[(y,x)]; seen[y,x]=1; pts=[]
  while q:
   yy,xx=q.pop(); pts.append((yy,xx))
   for dy in (-1,0,1):
    for dx in (-1,0,1):
     if not(dx or dy): continue
     ny,nx=yy+dy,xx+dx
     if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and m[ny,nx] and not seen[ny,nx]: seen[ny,nx]=1; q.append((ny,nx))
  comps.append(pts)
base=np.zeros_like(m,bool)
for pts in sorted(comps,key=len,reverse=True)[:2]:
 for y,x in pts: base[y,x]=1
base|=g
hard=np.asarray(Image.fromarray((base*255).astype('uint8')).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(13)))
blur=np.asarray(Image.fromarray(hard).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(4)))
mask=np.maximum(hard,blur).astype(np.uint8)
# Same live CSS eye-patch mapping used by the previous discriminator.
W,H=1536,1024; x0=round(W*.31); y0=round(H*.12); pw=round(W*.27); ph=round(pw*mask.shape[0]/mask.shape[1])
rm=np.asarray(Image.fromarray(mask).resize((pw,ph),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)); full=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); full[y0:y0+ph,x0:x0+pw]=rm
core=full>=240; nz=full>0
dil=np.asarray(Image.fromarray((nz*255).astype('uint8')).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(31)))>0
ring=dil&~nz
upper=np.zeros_like(nz); upper[max(0,y0-60):min(H,y0+ph+80),max(0,x0-100):min(W,x0+pw+100)]=1; upper &= ~nz
coeff=np.array([1.0,1/3,-1/3,-1.0],dtype=np.float64)
states=[]
for r in rolls:
 p=root/f'gier_+00_nick_+00_roll_{r}'
 fs=[sorted(p.glob(f'slice_{i}_*.png'))[0] for i in range(4)]
 A=np.stack([np.asarray(Image.open(f).convert('RGBA'))[:,:,3].astype(np.float64)/255 for f in fs])
 asum=A.sum(axis=0); ce=np.divide((A*coeff[:,None,None]).sum(axis=0),asum,out=np.zeros_like(asum),where=asum>1e-9); vis=asum>0
 rec={'state':r}
 for name,sel in [('EYE_CORE',core&vis),('EYE_NZ',nz&vis),('EYE_RING15',ring&vis),('UPPER_CONTROL',upper&vis)]:
  v=ce[sel]; assert v.size>0,(r,name); rec[name]=(float(v.mean()),float(np.quantile(np.abs(v),.9)),int(v.size))
 states.append(rec)
print('STATE_COUNT',len(states)); assert len(states)==11
print('ROLLS',','.join(rolls))
for r in states:
 print('STATE',r['state'],*(f'{k}:mean={r[k][0]:.6f},p90abs={r[k][1]:.6f},n={r[k][2]}' for k in ['EYE_CORE','EYE_NZ','EYE_RING15','UPPER_CONTROL']))
for amp in [0.25,0.5,1.0]:
 diffs=[abs(r['EYE_CORE'][0]-r['EYE_RING15'][0])*amp for r in states]
 ep90=[r['EYE_CORE'][1]*amp for r in states]
 print('AMP',amp,'CORE_RING_MEAN_DIFF_PX_MIN_MED_MAX',f'{min(diffs):.6f}',f'{np.median(diffs):.6f}',f'{max(diffs):.6f}','EYE_CORE_P90_EFFECTIVE_PX_MIN_MED_MAX',f'{min(ep90):.6f}',f'{np.median(ep90):.6f}',f'{max(ep90):.6f}')
print('MASK_SHA',hashlib.sha256(Image.fromarray(mask).tobytes()).hexdigest(),'CORE_PIXELS',int(core.sum()),'RING_PIXELS',int(ring.sum()))
print('LIVE_MUTATION=0')
print('SCOPE=READ_ONLY_PARALLAX_EYE_REGISTRATION_FIELD_V2')
PY
POST=$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')
echo POST_BUEHNE_SHA=$POST
test "$PRE" = "$POST"
